$comment: Semantics probes. corpusRefs re-verify entire oracle corpus tests (every row, both blank modes) against the real product — chosen because they are the current conformance failures or 🔬 items. probes are hand-written cases for NEEDS-VERIFICATION items with no corpus coverage.
